title: Edifice Watch EFV-600D-2AVUDF
description: A mid-size standard EDIFICE chronograph. The gradient color on the dial was inspired by the night sky during night races. Use of green coloring on the second hand and the inset dial hand creates a highly visible design.
features: 1/10-second stopwatch Measuring capacity: 59’59.9” Measuring modes: Elapsed time, split time, 1st-2nd place times
Regular timekeeping Analog: 3 hands (hour, minute, second), 3 dials (stopwatch 1/10 seconds, stopwatch minutes, stopwatch seconds)
Approx. battery life: 3 years on SR920SW.
